//@version=6
indicator("V52 qualifier-match-const-active", calc_bars_count=32)
sourceText = "abXab"
regexText = "[a-z]+"
value = str.match(source=sourceText, regex=regexText)
consumer = input.bool(true, "Consumer", active=value == "ab")
plot(consumer ? 1 : 0, "CONSUMER")
plot(str.length(value), "TARGET_LENGTH")
plot(value == "ab" ? 1 : 0, "TARGET_EQUAL")
plot(na(value) ? 1 : 0, "TARGET_NA")
if barstate.isfirst
    log.info("TARGET=[{0}]", value)
plot(bar_index, "INDEX")
plot(close, "CONTROL_CLOSE")
